name: rclone-serve
description: A fully self-contained rclone appliance: rclone's own official web GUI for guided remote setup (OAuth flows for OneDrive/Google Drive/Dropbox/etc. included) plus `rclone serve` to expose a configured remote over a protocol other tools already speak - most usefully restic's own REST backend - so restic can talk to a cloud provider it has no native driver for directly, without a separate scheduled sync job in between. Owns its own config entirely; no dependency on any other rclone install.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Where this container's own rclone.conf and settings are stored - independent of any other rclone install

ports.name: GUI Port
ports.description: Port for rclone's own web GUI (guided remote setup)

variables.name: GUI User
variables.description: Basic auth username for the config GUI - this is full control over your remotes' credentials

variables.name: GUI Password
variables.description: Basic auth password for the config GUI

variables.name: Remote
variables.description: The remote:path to serve, e.g. onedrive:backups - doesn't need to exist yet, just needs to be created eventually via the GUI

variables.name: Serve User
variables.description: Basic auth username for the serve endpoint

variables.name: Serve Password
variables.description: Basic auth password for the serve endpoint

variables.name: Serve Protocol
variables.description: restic, http, webdav, or sftp only - other rclone serve modes lack a compatible auth model and are rejected

variables.name: Extra Args
variables.description: Extra flags passed straight through to rclone serve
